author: richburdon
principle: Do not hand-copy data that already exists in production config/metadata into a story or test; derive it from the real source.
fix_shape: extract the duplicated literal to a shared const/metadata file, or generate it from config

author: richburdon
principle: Reuse an existing standard/shared type for a concern instead of defining a new bespoke one when a suitable standard type already exists.
fix_shape: swap the ad hoc type/props for the existing standard surface/role type

author: richburdon
principle: A new UI container/component should ship with a storybook story and an image snapshot of its resting state.
fix_shape: add a storybook story and attach a resting-state screenshot to the PR

author: richburdon
principle: Place each component in its own directory alongside its storybook story rather than as a loose file.
fix_shape: move the component into its own folder and add a co-located .stories file

author: richburdon
principle: Keep component-specific hooks inside the container component rather than in the thin surface/wiring registration layer.
fix_shape: move the hook call from the Surface.create wiring into the container component

author: wittjosiah
principle: Do not add a second renderer/view for a concern an existing view already serves unless it does something the existing one genuinely cannot.
fix_shape: drop the redundant renderer and reuse the existing view, or state the concrete gap it fills

author: wittjosiah
principle: When a component already uses the design system's primitives, build editable fields with its Form component rather than hand-rolled inputs and local state.
fix_shape: replace ad hoc input/state handling with the shared Form component

author: wittjosiah
principle: Extend or combine with an existing extensible mechanism (e.g. a role token) rather than defining a parallel one for a similar purpose.
fix_shape: fold the new role token's data into the existing token instead of adding a second one

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Expose only the narrow capability a caller actually needs on an existing service rather than granting access to the whole broader service.
fix_shape: add a single-purpose method to the existing narrower service instead of exposing the full service

author: richburdon
principle: Keep filenames within one folder to a single consistent naming convention.
fix_shape: rename files to match the folder's established pattern (e.g. all verb-first)

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep a shared protocol package limited to type definitions and a thin client API; put implementation details in the consuming package.
fix_shape: move non-typedef/implementation code out of the protocol package into the app-specific package

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Name a module's error definitions file `errors.ts` and export it from the package's top-level index.
fix_shape: rename the file to errors.ts and re-export it from index.ts

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not silence a lint rule with an inline disable comment when the underlying issue (e.g. an unused import) can be fixed properly.
fix_shape: remove the eslint-disable and fix the actual unused-import/lint cause

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Re-export a module as a named namespace (`export * as X from ...`) rather than a flat `export * from ...`, to preserve namespace identity.
fix_shape: change the re-export to `export * as Name from './Module'`

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A caught error that matters to correctness must produce a visible/observable failure for the caller, not just a log line.
fix_shape: propagate the caught error into a visible client-side error path while still keeping the log

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not write tests against a hand-written mock of an internal interface; extend the existing real-implementation test suite to cover the new edge cases instead.
fix_shape: delete the mock-based test file and add the new cases to the real integration test

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not wire new code into a mechanism that is already deprecated; delete the deprecated hook-up instead of extending it.
fix_shape: remove the registration/call into the deprecated global diagnostic mechanism

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer a build tool's built-in feature over a custom re-implementation of the same functionality.
fix_shape: use the tool's native option instead of the hand-rolled equivalent

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer a build tool's built-in feature over a custom re-implementation of the same functionality.
fix_shape: switch to the built-in declaration-generation feature instead of the custom tsc wrapper

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Reference the real symbol (e.g. a service's Context.Tag) instead of a hand-typed string duplicate of its identifier, so it stays correct across renames.
fix_shape: replace the string literal keys with references to the actual service tags

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A lower-level/foundational package must not know about a higher-level concept built on top of it; define that annotation/type in the higher-level package instead.
fix_shape: move the annotation out of the low-level package into the higher-level package that owns the concept

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A lower-level/foundational package must not know about a higher-level concept built on top of it; define that annotation/type in the higher-level package instead.
fix_shape: move the definition out of the low-level package into the package that owns the concept

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep package.json subpath export conditions mirrored between `source` and each built platform variant, rather than an asymmetric structure.
fix_shape: restructure the exports map so source and dist entries mirror the same branches

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Fold a new narrow filter/variant into the existing general-purpose mechanism instead of adding a parallel one.
fix_shape: merge the new filter tag into the existing FilterObject rather than defining a separate type

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Name a superseded schema version with an explicit version suffix, place it at the end of the file, and keep its migration colocated in the same module.
fix_shape: rename to `X_vN_N_N`, move it below the current schema, and add the migration in the same file

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Export a collection (e.g. migrations, plugins) as an array even when it currently has one element, so more can be added without changing the API shape.
fix_shape: wrap the single exported value in an array

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Add new optional methods to the core/shared interface rather than defining a separate extended interface, when all implementations can share it.
fix_shape: fold the new methods into the base interface instead of an extension interface

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not add a bespoke query hook that duplicates the general query mechanism; express it as a query against the existing generic API.
fix_shape: delete the specialized hook and use the generic query API with the right filter/selection instead

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When migrating off a deprecated mechanism, delete its remaining call sites and APIs rather than leaving them stubbed for a later migration.
fix_shape: stub out and remove the deprecated hook/APIs instead of partially migrating them

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When migrating off a deprecated mechanism, delete its remaining call sites and APIs rather than leaving them stubbed for a later migration.
fix_shape: stub out and delete the deprecated API rather than continuing to support it

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Context/cancellation disposal is cooperative, not preemptive — a caller waiting on a scheduled task must still wait for it to actually finish rather than returning early on context disposal, to avoid orphaned work producing unhandled rejections.
fix_shape: keep awaiting the task's completion instead of returning as soon as the context is disposed
